title: Starting Haul-Away Limit for Optional Coverage Add-Ons by Homeowner Tier
content:
The starting haul-away limit for equipment replaced under an Optional Coverage Add-Ons rider follows the tier of the base Homeowner Service Contracts contract. It draws on two allowances: the rider's own haul-away allowance, and the base tier's own haul-away allowance as that homeowner tier publishes it.

| Base homeowner contract tier | Starting haul-away limit |
|---|---|
| Bridgewell HomeCare Platinum | The higher of the rider's haul-away allowance and the tier's own haul-away allowance |
| Bridgewell HomeCare Gold | The average of the rider's and the tier's haul-away allowances |
| Bridgewell HomeCare Silver | The average of the rider's and the tier's haul-away allowances |
| Any other tier, or a base that is not a homeowner contract | The rider's own haul-away allowance |

The average of the two allowances is their total divided by two.

## Hypothetical figures

A rider haul-away allowance of USD 75.00 and a tier haul-away allowance of USD 125.00 (both hypothetical):

| Base tier | Starting haul-away limit |
|---|---|
| Bridgewell HomeCare Platinum | USD 125.00 |
| Bridgewell HomeCare Gold | USD 100.00 |
| Bridgewell HomeCare Bronze | USD 75.00 |
